headline: Congress named the Postal Service building at 17 East Main Street in Herington, Kansas, after Captain Emil J. Kapaun.
what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service facility in Herington, Kansas, as the Captain Emil J. Kapaun Post Office Building. It is a designation only and does not change how the post office operates. Mail service and postal rules stay the same.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on March 10, 2022.
